The method is: Whisk the starter into the water until no lumps remain, then add both flours and mix to a shaggy mass. Cover and autolyse for forty minutes. Shape into two tight boules, seam side up in floured baskets, then cold retard at 4 C overnight for twelve to fourteen hours. Bake straight from the fridge at 250 C with steam for twenty minutes, then vent the oven and drop to 230 C for a further twenty-five minutes until the crust is deeply coloured.
